Organic acid metabolism disorder; developmental delay 80-99% and intellectual disability/seizures 30-79% support neurologic injury. Pancreatitis 5-29%; renal disease rare.

Genetic generalized seizure disorder without established common damage to other organ axes.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction with bronchiectasis; chronic middle-ear disease occurs in 4/4. Recurrent infections reflect impaired clearance, not intrinsic immunodeficiency.
Defining aneurysms, cirrhosis and emphysema; cerebral calcification with developmental delay/seizures is a major component supporting neurologic involvement.
Inherited structural skeletal myopathy. Cardiac disease varies across subtypes without an established umbrella frequency; respiratory weakness does not establish direct lung damage.
Mitochondrial neuropathy with defining ophthalmoparesis; myopathy supported by weakness 7/7 and abnormal muscle histology. Hearing loss 30-79% and MVP 3/7 omitted at cap.
Defining neurodevelopmental disorder, dermal melanocytosis and strabismus; reduced GFR/chronic kidney disease occurs in 30-79%, supporting intrinsic renal involvement.
EBV-driven B-cell lymphoproliferation predominantly infiltrates lungs; CNS lesions occur in roughly 30-40%. Skin involvement around 30-50% omitted at cap; renal involvement usually <30%.
Congenital skin absence and intestinal lymphangiectasia; skull defects 80-99%; enteric immunoglobulin/lymphocyte loss 30-79% supports secondary immune deficiency.
Familial panic disorder is psychiatric; neurologic ancestry does not establish structural or functional neurologic disease.
Site-unspecified teratomas are predominantly gonadal reproductive tumors. Extragonadal sites vary and do not support an organ axis across most of this umbrella.
